name: Providenciales International Airport
before:
The main way into the Turks and Caicos, on the island of Providenciales. The territory is a British Overseas Territory, and this is one of two international airports, the other being JAGS McCartney on Grand Turk.

Note the name change. In 2023 the airport was renamed Howard Hamilton International, so both names are still in circulation and a client may see either on a ticket.

It handles more than 12,000 commercial aircraft movements a year, and the two local carriers, interCaribbean Airways and Caicos Express Airways, both run hubs here, which is how island hopping across the territory works.

There is one runway, 2,807 metres of asphalt, at an elevation of 15 feet. The runway extension and a terminal renovation were completed by December 2014.
